summary: Revision 3 requirements R9-R12 remain built (QA-1 fix included). This round fixes QA-2 only: R11's Start all / Stop all filters are now proven at the command level, not just on AppDef::executable_terminals. Tauri's mock runtime cannot be launched in this environment (STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND), so the command bodies were kept as the single source of truth: start_all and stop_all now delegate to start_all_in / stop_all_in, and a new unit-test module in src-tauri/src/commands.rs builds a real AppState and Runtime, starts real terminals, and runs those exact bulk loops. r11_start_all_command_starts_executable_terminals_and_skips_non_executable_ones proves start_all creates and runs only the executable terminal while the non-executable one is never even created; r11_stop_all_command_stops_executable_terminals_and_leaves_a_hand_started_non_executable_one_running proves stop_all stops the executable terminal but leaves a non-executable one the user started by hand running. Reverting either loop to app.terminals now fails these tests. The launch-time restore uses the same start_all, so it is covered. No other behaviour, file, dependency or version was changed.
